method: 1 can tuna, drained ( always get the ones in brine, not in oil )

caption:
Healthy Tuna Salad Recipe 
meal prep friendly | high protein | low fat | lunch box friendly | brunch 

Nutrition: 
C: 23 | F: 2 | P: 19
Calories: 183 per serve ( without bread ) 
Makes enough filling for 4 toasts ( 2 per person ) 

As always, if you have any questions about the recipe or how to execute it, leave a comment and i will respond to help you out <3 

Ingredients: 
1 can tuna, drained ( always get the ones in brine, not in oil ) 
2 - 3 pickles (gerkin) diced
1 diced onion
10 - 12 jalapeños, chopped
1/3 cup Greek yogurt + more if needed for a creamier texture
salt + pepper, to taste
secret ingredient : 1 tbsp maggi hot and sweet sauce

pro tip: 
add in another 1/2 cup greek yogurt to make it a great dip consistency or for salads
